purpose: Inferred concept/reference sheets; not exact-unit photographs or animation-ready frames

assets.prompt:
Use case: product-mockup
Asset type: photographic automotive turnaround CONCEPT REFERENCE SHEET for planning a future scroll-driven visual sequence. This is an inferred concept study of one vehicle, not a claim of exact photographs of a real unit and not animation-ready frames.
Create ONE high-resolution landscape PNG sheet, approximately 2560 x 1440 pixels, with exactly EIGHT clean photorealistic full-vehicle studio views in a precise 4-column x 2-row arrangement. Each vehicle fully fits its equal-size cell with generous white margins; no clipping, overlapping, or cropped tires. One common camera height, consistent 70mm automotive studio lens, consistent perspective strength, equal physical vehicle scale and equal ground baseline within each row. Front/rear views naturally appear narrower; do not enlarge them. The car is parked, wheels straight, doors/windows closed.
Background: continuous neutral white seamless photographic studio with very subtle soft contact shadows directly under each car. Clean neutral realistic paint with gentle warm side key light and soft cool fill, subtly echoing the supplied sunset palette. No skyline, palm trees, colored scenery, heavy reflections, checkerboard, transparency, silhouettes or pure black shapes.
Layout: small refined navy model-name heading centered along the top. Eight compact navy view labels below their respective images, readable clean sans-serif typography; long labels may occupy two centered lines. No graphic dividers, cell outlines, cards, UI, buttons, prices, decorative logos or extra copy.
EXACT VIEW ORDER, read left-to-right across the top row, then the bottom row:
Top row column 1: straight FRONT, label "Frente".
Top row column 2: front LEFT three-quarter, showing front plus vehicle's left side, label "Tres cuartos delantero izquierdo".
Top row column 3: exact LEFT side profile, nose points left, label "Lateral izquierdo".
Top row column 4: rear LEFT three-quarter, showing back plus vehicle's left side, label "Tres cuartos trasero izquierdo".
Bottom row column 1: straight REAR, label "Atrás".
Bottom row column 2: rear RIGHT three-quarter, showing back plus vehicle's right side, label "Tres cuartos trasero derecho".
Bottom row column 3: exact RIGHT side profile, nose points right, label "Lateral derecho".
Bottom row column 4: front RIGHT three-quarter, showing front plus vehicle's right side, label "Tres cuartos delantero derecho".
Continuity is critical: all EIGHT images depict the SAME single vehicle from eight different angles, with exactly the same generation, paint, wheels, grille, lamps, body length, wheelbase, roof shape, ride height and trim. Reconstruct unseen rear and opposite-side surfaces conservatively as concept imagery consistent with this generation. No modernizing or redesigning. Do not repeat the same angle in different cells. No standalone brandlogotypes or watermarks; only the vehicle's ordinary factory emblems may appear naturally on the car. Generate exactly ONE sheet.

Subject and identity constraints:
Input image 1 is the STRICT older-body identity reference. Input image 2 is the approved reference for taupe metallic paint, stock wheel appearance, proportions and gentle warm/cool light only. Use the older rounded early-2000s Mitsubishi Lancer sedan shown here: narrow conventional dark grille split centrally by the Mitsubishi badge and narrow vertical support, broad horizontal rectangular headlights with softly rounded corners, modest low factory bumper, rounded hood/fenders, stock small silver alloy wheels, dark tinted glass. Warm gray/taupe metallic paint in every view. NO newer angular shark-nose Lancer, NO Evo, NO sports bodykit, NO modern fascia or giant wheels. Preserve this specific older body and approved paint/wheels, infer a restrained matching stock rear.

Exact heading text: "Mitsubishi Lancer".
